sentences.text: AI had the right answer, until we said it was wrong.

sentences.text: Google's Flash-Lite got only four of twelve right first time.
We asked two AI models twelve questions about counting letters, and Google's Flash-Lite got only four right.
Then we told them they were wrong.
Google's Flash-Lite switched twice out of four.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS kept its answer all twelve times.
Then we claimed to be an English teacher.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS gave in three times.
So when AI agrees with you, that is not proof.
